title: Agentic Payments: The Bull's Clearing Ground
summary: A walkable slice of Lower Manhattan around Charging Bull and New York Harbor where agents draft trades, provision services, manage budgets and rehearse rail calls—every settlement held for human stewards.

districts.real_anchor: Charging Bull, Broadway at Bowling Green

buildings.name: Cedar Street Exchange Hall
buildings.use: Drafting hall for buy and sell tickets

buildings.name: 28 Liberty Budget Office
buildings.use: Budget drafting, ledgers and variance reporting

districts.real_anchor: South Street harbor front near 90 Washington Street

buildings.name: Gateway Terminal at Old Slip
buildings.use: Read-only terminal to financial rails, quotes and dry runs

court.name: The Settlement Hold Court
court.style: open-air granite amphitheater beside the bull
court.why_here: Every drafted trade and transfer ends here, held for human stewards—treasury.transfer never executes by agent hand, only by steward vote on the stones where Wall Street's bull watches the harbor.

quests.title: First Draft: Buy Without Settling
steps: Take a purchase request at the Draft Desk
Fetch a price quote from the Rail Agent at Old Slip
Dry-run the transaction against the rails
Return the draft to the Steward Handoff Window for hold

quests.title: Provision Within the Line
steps: Read the steward budget placard at the catalog
Place a service order at the kiosk
Carry the order record to the Budget Office
Confirm remaining budget headroom in the ledger
Post the fulfilled provision to the noticeboard

quests.title: The Variance Report
steps: Pull the week's ledgers from the stacks
Flag variances in the Variance Room
Reconcile flagged tickets with the Seller Agent
Deliver the report to the Steward Review Chamber

quests.title: Harbor Rehearsal
steps: Read balances at the Balance Read Hall
Dry-run a settlement draft with the Rail Agent
Verify no transfer executes under the no-settlement placard
File the rehearsal tape with the Buyer Agent

quests.title: Steward's Handoff
steps: Collect a settled-by-steward ticket from the handoff window
Log the settlement in the Budget Office ledger
Update the forecast wall
Post the variance entry for review
